svg.title: Detectra user flow adapted from the original Figma design
svg.desc: Main manual journey through upload or camera Scan Now, analysis, saved results, optional review, and confirmed feedback. This adaptation reflects the implemented multiclass application and local image storage. Automatic camera saving is a separate optional background workflow.

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Select a valid image
Click Analyze Image

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Open Camera Scan
Connect camera · Click Scan Now

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Analyze and save results
Show detections and confidence,
or no detections

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Select reviewer · Review result
Choose Correct or Incorrect
